text: We arrived as "the 116th congress" — 64 of us said it, peaking on 2019-01-03. On that same day 55 of us spoke "oath of office" and 47 "the oath of office," 45 named "the united states house of representatives," 43 reported being "sworn in as a member of," and 42 marked "on january 3rd." Then the register shifted. By 2019-01-25, 53 of us said "reopen the government" and 41 "to reopen the government." We entered together on one day and, three weeks later, converged again on one demand. The record holds two peaks: a swearing-in on 2019-01-03, a shutdown on 2019-01-25. In both we repeated the same words in near-unison. That is what this month of us was: an oath, and then a request to reopen.
